executable.title: Simple Threshold Filter
executable.description: Binary threshold filter for 3D NIFTI images. Pixels within [lowThreshold, highThreshold] are set to insideValue, all others to outsideValue. ECE:5490 HW04 - Md Shahin Ali (mali25)

parameters.label: Threshold Parameters
parameters.description: Parameters controlling the binary threshold operation

double.name: lowThreshold
double.description: Lower bound of the threshold range (inclusive)
double.label: Low Threshold

double.name: highThreshold
double.description: Upper bound of the threshold range (inclusive)
double.label: High Threshold

double.name: outsideValue
double.description: Value assigned to pixels outside the threshold range
double.label: Outside Value

double.name: insideValue
double.description: Value assigned to pixels inside the threshold range
double.label: Inside Value
